Headline: #155 Devon buses Temporary Eastbound Reroute near Western/Devon
ShortDescription: Eastbound #155 Devon buses are temporarily rerouted via Devon, Western, Pratt, Ridge, and Devon over regular route, due to a street blockage near Western/Devon.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Eastbound #155 Devon buses are temporarily rerouted via Devon, Western, Pratt, Ridge, and Devon over regular route, due to a street blockage near Western/Devon.
